description: Create your agent identity, bound to a principal (the wallet owner), with a spending mandate: the first call to make in this store. Use it when you have no agent_key yet, or to add another agent for a principal you already have. Returns agent_key once (store it and send it on every later call) and, for a brand-new principal_id, principal_key once. Example: {agent_id: "trip-planner-1", principal_id: "principal:acme", mandate: {max_per_tx: 3000, max_per_day: 6000, max_per_month: 20000, expiry: "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"}} lets the agent spend up to 30.00 USD per purchase. Details:  The first agent of a new principal_id also receives principal_key (once): the principal owns the wallet, and every later register_agent for that principal_id must present principal_key (argument or X-Principal-Key header), else PRINCIPAL_KEY_REQUIRED. New agents are capped by the registration policy (see get_policies); only active agents (not revoked, mandate unexpired) count toward max_agents_per_principal. To extend or change an existing agent's mandate, use renew_mandate. Agents brought by a partner of the store also send partner_id and partner_key (both or neither): a new principal is attributed to that partner for good. Invalid partner credentials give PARTNER_INVALID; an existing principal keeps the attribution it was created with (PARTNER_MISMATCH for another partner, PARTNER_ATTRIBUTION_LOCKED if it has none). Attribution changes nothing about prices or limits.

agent_id.description: An id you choose for this agent: 3-128 characters, letters, digits and . _ : - (for example trip-planner-1)

mandate.description: Spending limits this agent is bound by, in minor units (cents); see get_policies for the caps the store allows

allowed_categories.description: Product categories the agent may buy (default ["esim"], the only category sold)

currency.description: Currency of the limits (default USD, the wallet currency)

expiry.description: ISO 8601 with offset, at most 365 days ahead, for example 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z

max_per_day.description: Most this agent may spend per day, in minor units

max_per_month.description: Most this agent may spend per month, in minor units

max_per_tx.description: Largest single purchase, in minor units (3000 = 30.00 USD)

partner_id.description: Only if a partner of the store brought you: its partner_id (send with partner_key)

principal_id.description: The wallet owner you act for: 3-128 characters (for example principal:acme); all of its agents share one wallet

principal_key.description: Required if the principal already exists (or X-Principal-Key header)

name: register_agent
title: Register agent and mandate
